title: Past Simple Tense Practice
description: Practise the past simple tense to describe completed actions and events, including regular and irregular verbs.

body_markdown:
## 1. When do we use the past simple?

Use the past simple for actions or events completed in the past.

- I visited my friend yesterday.
- She cooked dinner last night.
- They went to the market.
- We watched a film on Sunday.

Common time expressions include yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago and in 2020.

## 2. Regular verbs

Many verbs form the past tense by adding **-ed**:

| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| work | worked |
| play | played |
| clean | cleaned |
| watch | watched |
| visit | visited |

Some spelling changes occur: study → studied; stop → stopped.

## 3. Irregular verbs

| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| go | went |
| eat | ate |
| see | saw |
| buy | bought |
| come | came |
| write | wrote |

These forms need practice and revision.

## 4. Negative sentences

Use **did not (didn't) + base verb**:

- I did not go there.
- She didn't call me.
- They didn't finish the work.

Do not use the past form after did not: say “didn't go”, not “didn't went”.

## 5. Questions

Use **Did + subject + base verb?**

- Did you visit your friend?
- Did he call you?
- Did they arrive on time?

## 6. Practice

Choose the correct answer.

1. I ______ to the shop yesterday. (go / went)
2. She ______ dinner last night. (cook / cooked)
3. They didn't ______ the bus. (miss / missed)
4. ______ you see him? (Did / Do)
5. He ______ a new phone last week. (buy / bought)

**Answers:** 1. went, 2. cooked, 3. miss, 4. Did, 5. bought.

## 7. Speaking task

Describe what you did yesterday using five past tense verbs.

faq.question: When should I use the past simple?
faq.answer: Use it for actions or events that were completed in the past.

faq.question: How do I make a negative past simple sentence?
faq.answer: Use did not or didn't followed by the base form of the verb.

faq.question: Are all past tense verbs formed with -ed?
faq.answer: No. Many common verbs are irregular, such as go/went and buy/bought.
